title: Larkspur Valuables Floater Coverage Features Comparison
content:
The Larkspur Valuables Floater tiers differ in how a scheduled loss is settled and which losses and extensions they include. The comparison below sets out each tier's coverage features.

## Settlement terms

| Tier | Deductible per occurrence (USD) | How a scheduled loss is settled | Fine art paid up to, percent of scheduled value, when market value has risen | Cash settlement, percent of the replacement cost to the carrier |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Valuables Floater Classic | 250 | least of repair, replacement or scheduled value | 100 | 100 |
| Valuables Floater Select | 100 | least of repair, replacement or scheduled value | 100 | 100 |
| Valuables Floater Preferred | 0 | least of repair, replacement or scheduled value | 100 | 100 |
| Valuables Floater Prestige | 0 | least of repair, replacement or scheduled value | 125 | 100 |
| Valuables Floater Collector | 0 | agreed value | 150 | 100 |
| Valuables Floater Private Client | 0 | agreed value | 150 | 100 |

A deductible of 0 means the tier has no deductible. A fine art figure of 100 means agreed value only: the scheduled value is the most paid for a piece of fine art.

## Included protections

| Tier | Unexplained (mysterious) disappearance of a scheduled item | Breakage of fragile fine art | Pair and set clause | Worldwide coverage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Valuables Floater Classic | covered | not covered | yes | yes |
| Valuables Floater Select | covered | not covered | yes | yes |
| Valuables Floater Preferred | covered | not covered | yes | yes |
| Valuables Floater Prestige | covered | covered | yes | yes |
| Valuables Floater Collector | covered | covered | yes | yes |
| Valuables Floater Private Client | covered | covered | yes | yes |

## Explanatory notes

- **Pair and set clause.** Where it applies, the loss of one item of a pair or set pays the reduction in value of the whole set.
- **Worldwide coverage.** Items are covered anywhere in the world on every tier.
- **Cash settlement.** When the insured declines a replacement the carrier can buy at a discount, the cash settlement is the stated percentage of what that replacement would cost the carrier. At 100 percent on every tier, a hypothetical replacement the carrier can buy for 3200 USD gives a cash settlement of 3200 USD.
- **Fine art above scheduled value (hypothetical).** A painting scheduled at 20000 USD: on the Valuables Floater Prestige at most 25000 USD (125 percent); on the Collector or Private Client at most 30000 USD (150 percent); on the Preferred at most 20000 USD.
